title: Twisted invariant matrices span over the separable closure
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $S=K^{\mathrm{sep}}$, $n\in\mathbf N$ and $b:\operatorname{Gal}(S/K)\to\operatorname{GL}_n(S)$ locally constant for the Krull topology. Put $T_g(M)=b(g)g(M)b(g)^{-1}$. Suppose $T_1(M)=M$ and $T_g(T_h(M))=T_{gh}(M)$ for all $g,h,M$. Let $A_b$ be the invariant matrix subalgebra of [def-sc-matrix-descent-invariants]. Then $\operatorname{span}_S(A_b)=\operatorname{Mat}_n(S)$, including $n=0$.

source.place: Tag 03R6 (Galois forms of matrix algebras); finite descent details expanded by an agent in lem-sc-matrix-descent-scalar-map-bijective steps 1--3

proof.text: Give GL_n(S) the discrete topology. Apply ProfiniteGrp.exists_openNormalSubgroup_right_invariant from [lem-exc-coinduced-functions-open-stabilizer] to b on the compact profinite absolute Galois group. Apply Mathlib krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_normal to the open stabilizer U to get a finite normal intermediate field E whose fixing subgroup lies in U. It is separable because it is a subfield of S, hence finite Galois. With q = AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E, IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker identifies ker(q) with E.fixingSubgroup. If q(g)=q(h), then g^(-1)h is in this fixing subgroup, so right invariance gives b(g)=b(h). This is the proved private helper finite_factorization.

Let L be the finite Galois subfield and choose the existing Mathlib lift s(sigma)=AlgEquiv.liftNormal sigma S; AlgEquiv.restrict_liftNormal gives q(s(sigma))=sigma. The explicit formula T_g(M)=b(g)g(M)b(g)^(-1) is additive and satisfies T_g(a M)=g(a)T_g(M). The hypotheses give T_1=id and T_g T_h=T_(gh). A standard matrix unit e_ij has entries 0 and 1, so every g fixes it entrywise. Thus q(g)=q(h) implies T_g(e_ij)=T_h(e_ij) using the equality of b-values. All these identities are written out in Lean; no action on Mat_n(L) is constructed.

For a in L and a standard matrix unit e_ij, define the actual finite sum A(a,i,j)=sum_sigma sigma(a) T_(s(sigma))(e_ij) over Gal(L/K), viewed in Mat_n(S). For any g in Gal(S/K), semilinearity and the action law transform each summand into (q(g)sigma)(a) T_(g s(sigma))(e_ij). The preceding restriction-fibre equality replaces T_(g s(sigma))(e_ij) by T_(s(q(g)sigma))(e_ij). Left multiplication by q(g) reindexes the finite sum, so T_g A(a,i,j)=A(a,i,j). By the carrier definition in [def-sc-matrix-descent-invariants], every A(a,i,j) belongs to A_b.

Let W=span_S(A_b). Fix i,j, and suppose e_ij is not in W. Mathlib Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_notMem gives an S-linear functional f with f(e_ij) nonzero and W contained in its kernel. Applying f to the invariant sums yields sum_sigma f(T_(s(sigma))(e_ij)) sigma(a)=0 for every a in L. The embeddings L -> S obtained by composing the inclusion with distinct K-automorphisms are distinct: injectivity follows from the inclusion being injective. Mathlib linearIndependent_monoidHom, restricted to this family, and Fintype.linearIndependent_iff therefore force every coefficient to be zero. At sigma=1, q(s(1))=q(1), so T_(s(1))(e_ij)=T_1(e_ij)=e_ij. This contradicts f(e_ij) being nonzero. Consequently every e_ij belongs to W.

Use Mathlib Matrix.matrix_eq_sum_single to write each matrix M as sum_i sum_j M_ij e_ij. Submodule closure under scalar multiplication and finite sums then puts every matrix in W, proving W=top. For n=0 both sums are empty and the same proof applies without a separate nonzero-dimension assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem matrixDescentInvariants_span (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    (b : (SeparableClosure K ≃ₐ[K] SeparableClosure K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (h1 : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K),
      (b 1).val * M * ((b 1)⁻¹).val = M)
    (hm : ∀ g h (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K)),
      (b g).val * ((b h).val * M.map h * ((b h)⁻¹).val).map g * ((b g)⁻¹).val =
        (b (g * h)).val * M.map (g * h) * ((b (g * h))⁻¹).val) :
    Submodule.span (SeparableClosure K)
      (Set.range fun a : matrixDescentInvariants K n b ↦
        (a : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))) = ⊤
